notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, attempting to deal 100 damage to Triskelion, but instead putting 100 +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion 100 times by removing 100 +1/+1 counters from it, dealing 100 damage divided among any number of targets.
